name: Differential Ray Marching
definition: A rendering technique that solves the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) in its differential form as an initial value problem, rather than approximating its integral form. This allows the application of numerical methods from differential equations to determine sampling steps, reducing sample count or increasing accuracy compared to traditional ray marching.
summary: Differential Ray Marching solves the Radiative Transfer Equation as an initial value problem using ODE solvers, avoiding the double transmittance integral of traditional methods to enable higher-order accuracy and adaptive step sizing.
